observations.wide: Both I128/U128 workloads: 513 to 2 requests, peak charged bytes 4096 to 32, zero collections and final charged storage. Recursive calls still consume stack. ARM64 adds/adcs and AMD64 addq/adcq operate on native register pairs.
observations.iteration: Direct count loops preserve checked successor and stage order, with no allocation or indirect tail call in the native inner loop. CLI/printing overhead is included; final 64 charged bytes are not a checked ARC reclamation claim.
observations.ad: Warm 129/257-leaf workspaces allocate no native buffers; the returned gradient allocates once (1040/2064 bytes). Oversized 16385-leaf workspaces release cached buffers; 96 bytes of native table metadata remain. Full per-platform artifacts accompany the numerical run.
observations.numerical: Equivalent Linux ARM64 array kernel medians C/Rust/fwp: 312822/321766/776215 ns; matrix: 562299/779478/555891 ns. Shared-runner samples describe these workloads, not universal parity. Metadata, allocation-inclusive timings and native code are in performance/comparison.json of the numerical artifact.
